title: Port Huron & St. Clair River Ship Times | Chris Izworski
description: When will the next freighter pass Port Huron, St. Clair, Marine City or Algonac? Live ship reports turned into tested passage windows, plus where to watch.
name: St. Clair River Ship Watch
eyebrow: Port Huron · Marysville · St. Clair · Marine City · Algonac
h1em: When will the next freighter pass your riverbank?
lede: Pick a town on the river. If a ship is already on its way, you get a tested window for when it should pass, worked out from its latest public position report and how fast ships really moved down and up this river in 2025.

port-huron.name: Thomas Edison Park Boardwalk
port-huron.description: Where Lake Huron becomes the St. Clair River under the Blue Water Bridges, with benches and open views. Ships turn close to shore here.

marysville.name: Chrysler Beach and the riverwalk
marysville.description: A riverfront park at the north end of Marysville's riverwalk, beside Marysville City Park.

st-clair.name: Palmer Park boardwalk
st-clair.description: The city's half-mile riverfront boardwalk beside downtown, with a self-guided Freighter Walk of marked plaques.

marine-city.name: Water Street riverfront parks
marine-city.description: Eight walkable waterfront parks along Water Street between Bridge and Pearl streets.

algonac.name: Algonac Riverfront Park boardwalk
algonac.description: A half-mile boardwalk on the river in town; Algonac State Park's riverfront is a few miles north.
algonac.address: Algonac riverfront, St. Clair River Drive
